_readme: Free page read for College of the Canyons' census lever 3 (S691, reread worker): 101 noncredit programs the 2026-27 credit catalog read (run 44769429877) found no page for. A 2023-24 extract of the catalog's School of Personal and Professional Learning pages exists on the college's site, so this read asks whether the 2026-27 catalog v3 prints those programs, on which pages and under what heading, and what the school's own page links for the current year. One load of each; robots.txt first, the census user agent, 4 s between loads.

questions.nc_in_catalog: Whether the 2026-27 catalog v3 prints the noncredit Certificates of Completion and Competency, on which PDF pages, and how each program's heading and course list read.
questions.nc_elsewhere: Whether the School of Personal and Professional Learning links a current-year noncredit catalog or program pages.
